about: Terms for the client quote page and PDF. Edit ipd-terms.txt, then run ipd-audit-scripts/terms-version.js record "what changed". Never edit files in history/.

business.source: Name, ABN and logo as in ServiceM8 (company record and quote PDF, 20 Nov 2026). The server re-reads name and ABN from ServiceM8 each day. QBCC licence from Matt, 20 Nov 2026.

keyTerms: This quote is valid for 30 days. Prices include GST unless the quote says otherwise.
A deposit applies on jobs over $1,000. On staged jobs, each stage is invoiced when that stage is complete, as shown on this quote. The final balance is due on completion (COD).
Extra work or changes must be agreed in writing before they start, and are charged at our standard rates.
Allowances are our best estimate. If the real cost will be different, we tell you and agree it in writing first.
Hidden or unexpected problems (such as damaged drains, hidden pipes or asbestos) and rock are extra. For hidden problems we stop and agree the next step with you first.
Cutting, breaking or removing concrete, paving, tiles or other hard surfaces is extra unless the quote lists it.
Making good (walls, tiles, paint, concrete, landscaping) and other trades are not included unless the quote lists them.
Our workmanship is warranted for the life of the installation. Product warranties are with the manufacturer.
If you cancel after accepting, you pay for work done and costs already incurred.
